info.name: VirtuJudge Backend API (Complete End-to-End Suite)
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman test collection for the VirtuJudge Backend control plane.

Covers 100% of public REST, real-time SSE, direct storage, and internal AI worker endpoints:
- System Health & Readiness
- Supabase Auth (Sign Up, OTP Verification, Passwordless Login, Password Auth, Refresh Token, Multi-user)
- Just-In-Time (JIT) User Provisioning
- Teams, Memberships, Concurrency (ETag / If-Match), & Ownership Transfer
- Team Invitations, Resend Rate Limiting, Public Previews, & Acceptance
- Projects, Search Filtering, Metadata Updates, & Erasure Deletion Requests
- Direct S3 / MinIO Presigned Binary Uploads, Checksum Verification, & Versioning
- Practice Session Lifecycle, Manifest Freezing, & Real-Time SSE Event Streaming
- Analysis Attempts, Policy Consent, Retries, & Cancellations
- Speaker Diarization Mappings & Validation
- Internal AI Worker Callbacks & Lifecycle Updates (Started, Progress, Analysis, Report, Failed, Cancelled)
- Multi-Turn Q&A Rounds, Presigned Answer Audio Uploads, Submissions, & Question Skips
- Rubric Evaluations, Findings, Scoring Components, & Executive Summaries
- Async PDF Report Generation, Polling, & Presigned Download Verification
- Complete Security & Boundary Negative Tests (401, 403, 404, 409, 412, 413, 415, 422, SSE Token Rejection)
